title: Message Bus Document
description: One user-DB message-bus document: who sent it, the raw content, and when it was sent. The store's delivery API returns this shape and the per-harness delivery hooks inject it into session context.

sender.description: The sending session's full identity — identity is REQUIRED at send, so both halves are always present on a delivered message.

sessionId.description: The sending session's harness session id.

projectId.description: The sending session's resolved project id (the cwd resolver's space).

content.description: The message body as a raw string, stored and injected verbatim.

timestamp.description: ISO-8601 UTC send time; feeds the 4-day retention window.
